parameters.formDescription: Demo form for the Lead → CRM AI pipeline. Every submission becomes a scored CRM row in about 30 seconds.

values.placeholder: Tell us what you need and by when

nodes.name: Form trigger
nodes.notes: source_channel = form_site

nodes.name: Gmail trigger
nodes.notes: source_channel = email_inbound. Filter -in:draft is mandatory: this workflow creates Gmail drafts, without the filter it would trigger itself forever.

nodes.name: Webhook lead intake
nodes.notes: POST JSON with source_channel + fields from the SOURCES map. Header x-webhook-secret. Answers when the run is done.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 'ok', workflow: $workflow.name, time: new Date().toISOString() } }];

nodes.name: Normalize lead
nodes.notes: Canonical object + dedupe_key + lead_type. SOURCES map lives here.

nodes.name: Register lead
nodes.notes: Create or Update by dedupe_key. Returns the stored row: previous touches / created_at come back for free.

nodes.name: Route by lead type
nodes.notes: thin → rule only · thin_comment → AI prompt A · rich → enrichment + AI prompt B

nodes.name: Rule scoring
nodes.notes: Spec §6. No LLM call.

nodes.name: Fetch company site
nodes.notes: Public home page only, no keys. Retries live in the loop below, not in Retry on Fail.

nodes.name: Build prompt
nodes.notes: Prompt A (thin_comment) or B (rich). Strict suffix on retry. COMPANY block is the only thing to edit.

nodes.name: AI qualify
nodes.notes: One narrow judgment. Output = JSON contract (spec §3). Primary + fallback model.

nodes.name: Gemini model
nodes.notes: Temperature 0 (spec §7). Model is a dropdown: swap here, nothing else changes.

nodes.name: Gemini fallback model
nodes.notes: Used only when the primary model call fails (e.g. 503).

nodes.name: Output schema
nodes.notes: Layer 2. Auto-fix stays off on purpose (known bugs); layer 4 is the Code validator.

nodes.name: Validate contract
nodes.notes: Layer 4, mandatory. LeadIQ-AI parser pattern.

nodes.name: Classify AI error
nodes.notes: Retry 408/409/425/429/5xx with backoff + jitter. Never 400/401/403/404/422.

nodes.name: Resolve contract
nodes.notes: 3rd failure → score 50, warm, needs_review.

nodes.name: Prepare routing
nodes.notes: Decides, never executes. Frozen ROUTES + reply templates.

nodes.name: Save qualification
nodes.notes: Second upsert by dedupe_key. Continue on Error, no retries: a retry here would mean duplicate writes.

nodes.name: Telegram alert
nodes.notes: parse_mode HTML: the default Markdown breaks on underscores (ads_google).

nodes.name: Route by heat
nodes.notes: Drafts only, nothing is sent. Phone-only leads skip Gmail.

nodes.name: Gmail draft hot
nodes.notes: Personal draft, never sent. Lands in the thread for email leads.

nodes.name: Gmail draft warm
nodes.notes: Personal draft or nurture template.

nodes.name: Gmail draft cold
nodes.notes: Template reply as a draft (switch to Send for a real auto-reply).

nodes.name: Build run row
nodes.notes: Runs row on every path + HTTP response for webhook leads.

nodes.name: Log run
nodes.notes: Always written: ok / retry / error.

parameters.jsCode:
// Last node on purpose: the intake webhook answers with this item ("last node" response mode).
return [{ json: $('Build run row').first().json.response_body }];

nodes.name: Webhook response
nodes.notes: Body for webhook callers: the qualification, or ok:false + errors. Unused for form / Gmail runs.

parameters.content:
### Add your source here → map to canonical fields
One entry in `SOURCES` inside **Normalize lead** and your trigger wired into it. Missing fields are fine: the lead becomes `thin` and goes through the rule.
